<!doctype html>
<html lang="it">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Scattia — Menù</title>
<meta name="description" content="Menù virtuale della pizzeria Scattia. Pizze, pizze particolari, pizze modellate, calzoni e specialità.">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#151515">
<style>
:root{--bg:#111;--panel:#1b1b1b;--panel2:#222;--text:#f7f3ea;--muted:#bcb7ae;--accent:#d89a27;--line:#393939;}
*{box-sizing:border-box} html{scroll-behavior:smooth} body{margin:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% -10%,#2a241c 0,#111 38%);color:var(--text);font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,Segoe UI,Roboto,Arial,sans-serif;line-height:1.45}
header{min-height:58vh;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:42px 20px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 30%,#292929 0,#171717 52%,#0f0f0f 100%)}
header:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(0,0,0,0),rgba(0,0,0,.10))}
.hero{position:relative;z-index:1;text-align:center;max-width:980px;width:100%}
.logo{width:min(760px,92vw);max-height:210px;object-fit:contain;margin-bottom:18px}
.kicker{letter-spacing:.26em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#e5a43a;font-size:.82rem;font-weight:700}
h1{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:clamp(3rem,8vw,6rem);margin:8px 0 6px;letter-spacing:.02em}
.subtitle{color:#eee;max-width:620px;margin:0 auto;font-size:1.05rem}
.wrap{max-width:1150px;margin:auto;padding:28px 18px 80px}
.sticky{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:20;background:rgba(17,17,17,.9);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:12px 14px}
.nav{max-width:1150px;margin:auto;display:flex;gap:8px;overflow:auto;scrollbar-width:none}
.nav a{white-space:nowrap;text-decoration:none;color:#ddd;border:1px solid #454545;border-radius:999px;padding:8px 13px;font-size:.86rem}
.nav a:hover{border-color:var(--accent);color:#fff}
.search{margin:26px auto 12px;display:flex;max-width:760px}
.search input{width:100%;padding:15px 18px;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid #484848;background:#191919;color:#fff;font-size:1rem;outline:none}
.search input:focus{border-color:var(--accent)}
.section-heading{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr;align-items:center;gap:16px;margin:48px 0 22px}
.section-heading span{height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#5a5a5a)}
.section-heading span:last-child{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#5a5a5a,transparent)}
h2{font-family:Georgia,serif;margin:0;font-size:clamp(1.7rem,4vw,2.35rem);text-align:center}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(285px,1fr));gap:14px}
.card{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#202020,#181818);border:1px solid #343434;border-radius:18px;padding:20px;min-height:145px;transition:.2s transform,.2s border-color,.2s box-shadow}
.card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:#5b4b31;box-shadow:0 14px 35px rgba(0,0,0,.22)}
.card-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:15px;align-items:flex-start}
.section-label{color:#a9a39a;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.12em;font-size:.67rem;margin-bottom:4px}
h3{font-size:1.22rem;margin:0;font-weight:800}
.price{color:#e8a33a;font-weight:800;font-size:1.02rem;white-space:nowrap}
.card p{color:#d1cec8;margin:14px 0 0;font-size:.96rem}
.muted{color:#8e8b86}
.badge{display:inline-block;margin-top:13px;color:#111;background:#9b9891;border-radius:999px;padding:4px 9px;font-size:.66rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.06em}
.unavailable{opacity:1}
footer{border-top:1px solid var(--line);text-align:center;color:#8f8b84;padding:34px 18px 50px;font-size:.85rem}
.hidden{display:none!important}
@media(max-width:600px){header{min-height:52vh}.logo{max-height:145px}.grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.card{padding:18px}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<header>
 <div class="hero">
   <div class="kicker">Pizzeria • Menù digitale</div>
   <img class="logo" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Logo Scattia">
   <h1>Menù</h1>
   <p class="subtitle">Scopri le nostre pizze, le specialità, i calzoni e le proposte della casa.</p>
 </div>
</header>

<div class="sticky"><nav class="nav"><a href="#fritti">Fritti</a><a href="#bevande">Bevande</a><a href="#birre">Birre</a><a href="#dettagli-azienda">Azienda</a><a href="#pizze-classiche">Pizze Classiche</a><a href="#pizze-particolari">Pizze Particolari</a><a href="#pizze-modellate">Pizze Modellate</a><a href="#calzoni">Calzoni</a><a href="#specialit">Specialità</a></nav></div>
<main class="wrap">
  <div class="search"><input id="search" type="search" placeholder="Cerca una pizza o un ingrediente…" aria-label="Cerca nel menù"></div>
  <p id="empty" class="muted hidden" style="text-align:center;padding:25px">Nessun risultato trovato.</p>

<footer>Scattia · Menù digitale<br><span>Prezzi come da menù fornito.</span></footer>
<script>
const input=document.getElementById('search'), empty=document.getElementById('empty');
const cards=[...document.querySelectorAll('.card')], sections=[...document.querySelectorAll('.menu-section')];
input.addEventListener('input',()=>{
 const q=input.value.trim().toLowerCase();
 let shown=0;
 cards.forEach(c=>{const ok=!q||c.dataset.search.includes(q);c.classList.toggle('hidden',!ok);if(ok)shown++;});
 sections.forEach(s=>s.classList.toggle('hidden',[...s.querySelectorAll('.card')].every(c=>c.classList.contains('hidden'))));
 empty.classList.toggle('hidden',shown!==0);
});
</script>
